text_block_list.text:
Claiming a brilliant 1st place in the 
Arima Kinen to shine as the final star of 
the year was none other than— The 
first-class Umamusume, King Halo!

Just before the Winning Live. The one 
ringing her cell phone was her mother. Yet 
King Halo didn't let it fluster her 
anymore.

Right there over the phone, she declared 
that she would surpass her mother. 
Someday, she proclaimed, the world would 
know her mother simply as "King Halo's 
mother."

Handing her phone to the Trainer, she 
dashed off. An awkward daughter and an 
awkward mother. Listening to their 
conversation, the Trainer quietly 
reflected on their bond.
